name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Malerhäuslhof
beschreibung: The Malerhäuslhof is a genuine farm in Ebbs offering self-catering holiday apartments. Accommodating between two and six guests, each apartment features a private terrace. As an active dairy and cattle farm, it offers visitors the unique opportunity to experience authentic farm life up close. A children's playground and a pond are located right on the grounds. Numerous scenic excursions into the surrounding mountain peaks are easily reached, and the popular Hechtsee lake is just a short drive or walk away. The peaceful location and direct harmony with nature define this Alpine getaway.
